topics.title: Stern Discusses Phoebe and Gilbert’s Interactions
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses his observations of Phoebe’s increasingly uninhibited behavior with men, particularly her interactions with Gilbert Gottfried. They explore Gilbert's nonchalant attitude while discussing Bedtown USA’s mattress ordering service and attempting to elicit a song from Phoebe using Jimmy Reed’s “You Got Me Running.”

topics.title: Black Crows and Mississippi Queen – Bathroom Revelations
topics.summary: Gilbert Godfrey and Phoebe Snow discuss Jessica’s experiences with Sam and Jim Baker, including accusations of rape, financial schemes, and a bizarre encounter with ‘black crows.’ The broadcast features rapid shifts in conversation covering details about bathroom habits, attempts to analyze the lyrics' meaning, and callers offering opinions on the events.

topics.title: Radio Show Mishap with Jim Baker
topics.summary: During a bizarre radio segment, hosts Jessica and Sam discuss imprisoned money-maker Jim Baker while engaging in absurd speculation about his situation including multiple breasts. topics.title: Strange Restaurant Reviews & Animal Welfare Investigation
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss bizarre Tex-Mex restaurant innovations like jalapeno fettuccine and vegetable chimichangas before transitioning to reporting on an arrest involving alleged bestiality with twenty adopted dogs from local shelters. The discussion includes concerns about animal cruelty laws and the investigation by authorities.

topics.title: Dog Adoption Investigation and Legal Disputes
topics.summary: An investigation unfolds after authorities discover Presley repeatedly adopting female dogs from a municipal pound, leading to accusations of sexual abuse due to fur found in his zipper. The case involves bizarre phone calls, legal disputes concerning Paul Newman’s salad dressing, and concerns about potential animal cruelty.

topics.title: Lennon and Ono Birthday Disputes
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss the escalating disputes surrounding Yoko Ono and Cynthia Lennon’s separate birthday celebrations for John Lennon. The conversation includes claims of attempts to ‘get him back,’ bizarre references to dog-tieing rituals, and commentary on legal issues related to both women, alongside an unsuccessful search for a new news anchor.
